content:
IncidentBot: PAGING ALERT • api-gateway-prod high 502/504 rate detected • 5xx_rate=14.7% over 5m • paging oncall • playbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/gateway/502s

Taylor_oncall: Oncall here. I'm seeing the alert in NewRelic and Grafana — large spike started ~1912351100. Anyone seen error traces?

Jessica_prod: digging in. Gateway logs show repeated: `upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream` and some `upstream prematurely closed connection`. Looks cross-region: us-west and central-eu.

Luke_netops: LB frontends healthy. Checking NLB target health -> most targets healthy but a subset of pods have HC failures. Running `kubectl describe pod gateway-edge-7c9b-... -n prod` shows repeated `read failed` on socket layer.

Infra_bot: NOTE: kernel tcp parameters on gateway nodes show `net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=0` and `net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range=32768 60999`. Current ephemeral ports consumption at 85% on node i-0a1b2c3.

Taylor_oncall: Could be ephemeral port exhaustion causing upstream resets. Action: 1) scale gateway-edge by +4 replicas; 2) temporarily reduce keepalive timeout between gateway and upstream; 3) enable fail-fast circuit on heavy endpoints. I'll kick off scaling now.

deploy-bot: Executing: `kubectl scale deployment/gateway-edge -n prod --replicas=12` — success (replicas: 8 -> 12).

CRM_support: CS reporting customer reports for `POST /v1/chat` and `POST /v1/autocomplete`. Two enterprise customers reported interruptions; logged IDs: CUST-4981, CUST-4999. Posting initial notify.

Jessica_prod: After scaling, 502 rate drops slightly to 9.5% but still elevated. Seeing a queue build on upstream model-service with high connection backlog (`SYN_RECV` spikes). Also redis latency p99 at 800ms — may be cascading.

Luke_netops: Adding a weighted route to divert 25% of non-auth traffic to secondary region to relieve pressure. Applying via traffic-controller. Patch: `{"routes":[{"region":"us-west-2","weight":75},{"region":"eu-central-1","weight":25}],"match":"path_prefix:/v1/chat,/v1/generate"}`

Infra_bot: ACTION: tuning ephemeral ports and keepalive. Proposed sysctl changes: `net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range=15000 61000`, `net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1`, `net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout=30`. Will deploy via daemonset after approval.

Taylor_oncall: Approve daemonset tweak for ephemeral ports and tcp_tw_reuse. Defer FIN timeout change until postmortem. Rolling sysctl change to affected gateway nodes now.

deploy-bot: sysctl daemonset rollout started -> 4/4 nodes updated.

Jessica_prod: Good signal: 5xx down to 4.1% in the last 3m after routing + sysctl + scale. Redis p99 trending down to ~220ms.

Taylor_oncall: Mitigation checklist update: - scale -> done; - weighted routing -> done; - sysctl tweaks -> done; - enable short circuit breaker (backend timeout 800ms) -> applying to gateway config.

Luke_netops: Circuit breaker applied. Also increasing upstream keepalive connections from 50 -> 150 to reduce churn.

IncidentBot: EVENT LOGGED • mitigation.actions: scale(8->12) by taylor_oncall at 1912351310; routing.patch by luke_netops at 1912351389; sysctl.daemonset by infra_bot at 1912351500; circuit_breaker by jessica_prod at 1912351680.

CRM_support: Customer update posted: "We've identified elevated 5xx rates and applied mitigations (scaling and routing changes). We're monitoring; will follow up with details." CS requests follow-up timeline.

Taylor_oncall: We'll hold monitoring. If 5xx < 1% for 45m, start rollback of weighted routing back to normal over 15m. Setting temporary autoscaler floor to 10 and ceiling to 30 for next 8 hours.

Jessica_prod: Note: we saw one unhealthy upstream process on model-worker group — restarted that pod; investigating memory growth. Creating ticket RW-INC-2230 (model-worker mem leak?) and RW-INC-2231 (post-incident).

Luke_netops: Confirming network ACLs unchanged; no firewall events during window. LB stats show increased connection churn prior to spike. Hypothesis: sudden client retry fanout + upstream slow responses -> hit ephemeral port limits + upstream connection resets -> 502 cascade.

Taylor_oncall: Handoff: I'm scheduling morning shift to pick up at 1912354400. Leaving runbook notes and actions inPagerDuty. Please keep updates here if we see re-escalation.

CRM_support: CS will email affected customers with incident ID RW-INC-2231 and offer credit if SLA breached.

Jessica_prod: Leaving: will write up root-cause hypothesis and attach logs. Follow-ups: infra to finalize sysctl daemonset PR to make safe defaults; infra to audit keepalive settings across services; platform to consider backpressure controls at router level.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT_STATUS • mitigated -> monitoring. No active paging at 1912354520. Follow-ups created in JIRA: RW-INC-2231 (incident-summary), RW-INC-2230 (model-worker-investigation), RW-OPS-587 (sysctl-defaults).
